## 🚨 The 5 stories that mattered most

- ✅ CONFIRMED **RBI tightens currency rules to defend the rupee amid record foreign selling**: The week began with Indian state lenders raising loan interest rates after the central bank raised its benchmark repo rate to **5.50%** [[DD News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxNUWl2N2hPTVQ1d2NzVGlFc2NRX2F5MFJmaUtScmxNMUN3S2dDVEtUUG1sUlNjcGl6OTdrWmkyNlEwbUNsMktVdzZuNHpweUl2N2tzY3U1MnlUQzgtVV9jdVR3OVA0SXVvbEFsZGNWcVFoM2VaSHRIaFVGOWx2TmJzVFFORVZxTWNkaXRtMlRLcldWYkhNc1RTZXNkLW4?oc=5). As global crude oil held high at **$104.72 per barrel**, the Reserve Bank opened a dedicated dollar window for state oil refiners to ease currency pressure [[The Tribune]](https://news.google.?oc=5). By the weekend, with foreign portfolio investors pulling **₹44,166 crore** from Indian equities in October, the RBI lowered the daily dollar transaction ceiling to **$5 million** in currency derivative markets to stop speculative short bets as the rupee traded near ₹96.78 [[News On AIR]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPa0M3bGVJRG9JRnpwNWxKbWNOMzJHeHdMOVBoS1UxUFRmdXNZVmdmdDVfVG1MZW10aTl1R0RLTmh5STh0c1pFemhkTHdzN0pYMTZ6SVk1MGJLanlpclhWNmR6c01WcjdZUkRmb29saDEyb3Bmb1EwWW41NldTQjE5WjFyajdXMzJ3ZUJHV2FRTmcxbEJpRC01X2EwOXh3cWxjcHl5Rko0azg?oc=5) [[NDTV Profit]](https://news.google.?oc=5). *Why it matters:* Prevents runaway currency depreciation and safeguards domestic financial stability against global energy shocks and massive capital flight.

- 🔵 PROPOSED **US floats $70,000 OPT fee while tech firms downplay green card freezes**: A controversial US policy proposal emerged seeking an unprecedented **$70,000 fee on OPT** (Optional Practical Training) permits for international graduates [[The Economic Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5). Alongside this, major Indian IT companies addressed freezes on US Department of Labor **PERM labor certifications**, clarifying that existing **H-1B work visas remain fully valid** and client operations face no disruption [[Hindustan Times]](https://news.google.
